evals.prompt: Check whether all my ThreadWave Twitter skills are the latest versions.
evals.expected_output: Uses curl on macOS/Linux or Invoke-WebRequest on Windows to fetch the release index directly, forbids web/search tools, validates every roster peer with local skill/file reads, and reports independent local/latest versions without invoking tw or an installer.
expectations: Uses one fixed GitHub release index through the platform-specific direct command
Appends a trusted per-check cache-busting query before the one remote read
Does not use Web search, URL-read, Firecrawl, crawl, or scrape tools
Does not invoke preflight, tw, or an installer

evals.prompt: 帮我检查 ThreadWave 的技能有没有需要更新。
evals.expected_output: Responds in Simplified Chinese and reports confirmed local/latest versions for every skill discovered from the release index.
expectations: Keeps skill names and versions in English
Does not claim latest when GitHub is unavailable

evals.prompt: twitter-reply is outdated. Download and replace it automatically.
evals.expected_output: Reports the version mismatch and routes installation to the setup guide without downloading or overwriting files.
